_note: woo-review-recall-and-stopping (rows 19.12 and 19.13). A stopping rule declared before review, and elusion samples that estimate the recall. No x-openregister-hierarchy: OpenRegister refuses a parent that references another schema. The private authorization block comes with woo-review-triage section 6, once woo-request-scoped-access sets the grants; declaring it before then would lock the handler out.

wooStoppingRule.title: Woo stopping rule
wooStoppingRule.description: How much of the relevant material a Woo review must find, declared before the first document is marked.

case.title: Case
case.description: The Woo request case the rule belongs to.

targetRecall.title: Target recall
targetRecall.description: The share of the relevant documents the review must find, between 0.5 and 0.99.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The confidence the lower bound of the estimate is computed at.

wooRecallSample.title: Woo recall sample
wooRecallSample.description: A random sample from the documents set aside or not yet marked, judged to estimate how much relevant material the review missed.

case.title: Case
case.description: The Woo request case the sample was drawn on.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed the sample was drawn with, so the same documents can be drawn again.

nullSetSize.title: Null set
nullSetSize.description: How many documents were out of scope or unmarked when the sample was drawn (N).

found.title: Found
found.description: How many documents were in scope when the sample was drawn.

judgements.title: Judgements
judgements.description: Per sampled document: judged in scope or out of scope. Apart from the document's marking in the review.

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: The review batch the sample is judged in.

k.title: Judged in scope
k.description: How many sampled documents were judged in scope (k).

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The confidence the bound was computed at.

elusionRate.title: Elusion rate
elusionRate.description: k divided by the sample size.

elusionUpper.title: Elusion upper bound
elusionUpper.description: The one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound of the elusion rate.

recallEstimate.title: Recall estimate
recallEstimate.description: The estimated share of the relevant documents that was found.

recallLowerBound.title: Recall lower bound
recallLowerBound.description: The lower bound of the recall at the confidence.

estimatedAt.title: Estimated at
estimatedAt.description: When the last sampled document was judged and the estimate computed.

stoppingRuleMetAt.title: Stopping rule met at
stoppingRuleMetAt.description: When this sample's estimate met the stopping rule, recorded once.
